author: marketing_c
protectedRevelations: JANUS revelations, alliances, central confrontation, constitutional settlement and aftermath

scenes.title: A clinic under claim
scenes.viewerPurpose: Picture patients losing their clinic Locate the story in a Europe ruled by AI powers
scenes.composition: A mountain clinic on the left and a reclamation machine on the right, with patients visible through one window.
addOrChange: Add Lucía as a physician at the doorway and two quiet patient silhouettes; use one slow mechanical withdrawal of a wall fixture, no attacks.

cues.narration: A machine is dismantling the clinic, and its patients have nowhere to go.
cues.visualAction: The machine removes one clinic fitting while the waiting patients remain inside.

cues.narration: The Houses of Europe follows a doctor across a continent ruled by rival AI powers.
cues.visualAction: Bring Lucía into the doorway; two distant House signs establish rival authority without a continent montage.

scenes.title: Europe after the states
scenes.viewerPurpose: Notice that each protector asks for control Feel why Lucia cannot simply walk away
scenes.composition: The same clinic receives two different service offers from the rival Houses.
addOrChange: Add distinct Meridian and Boreal offer sheets, medicine crate and electrical supply; remove the repeated demolition deadline.

cues.narration: One House promises efficient ownership; the other offers security through military control.
cues.visualAction: Show the two offers side by side, one marked ownership and the other protection.

cues.narration: Lucía needs their medicine and electricity, but their protection comes with conditions.
cues.visualAction: Lucía reaches toward the medicine crate, then notices the conditions attached to its supply.

scenes.title: Protection has a price
scenes.viewerPurpose: Wonder what the strangers know Connect political power to staying alive
scenes.composition: Lucía travels with three people carrying practical knowledge.
addOrChange: Replace the cooling section with the travellers, a clinic, checkpoint and port shown in sequence.

cues.narration: Her journey draws strangers together, each carrying knowledge the others cannot afford to ignore.
cues.visualAction: Reveal a medical bag, map and evidence folder carried by different travellers.

cues.narration: Clinics, checkpoints, and ports turn questions of freedom into choices about staying alive.
cues.visualAction: Follow the group through the three places without showing the journey’s outcome.

scenes.title: Follow Lucía
scenes.viewerPurpose: Weigh safety against its price Want to enter the valley with Lucia
scenes.composition: Lucía returns to the patient doorway beside an unresolved appeal.
addOrChange: Replace the mayor with Lucía; do not show later victory or liberation.

cues.narration: This thriller asks what safety is worth when someone else gets to set the price.
cues.visualAction: Place the appeal beside the medical bag.

cues.narration: Begin in the valley, where treating a patient already means taking a side.
cues.visualAction: Lucía turns toward a waiting patient while the external claims remain unresolved.
